subject: Pricing and model list for POC — per‑1M IO rates
messages:
From: Elliot Thomas <elliot@lumenhealth.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@lumenhealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Aug 2029 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Quick ask: per‑1M IO rates + model lineup for hosted API (POC)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — we’re kicking off a short POC to replace an existing text‑generation inference stack and want to model economics before committing resources. Two quick asks so we can complete our internal finance worksheet: 1) Redwood’s standard per‑1M token pricing split (input vs output) for your hosted API across the currently recommended model tiers for production, and 2) a concise list of supported/verified model names for the hosted catalog (we care about a low‑latency chat model and a smaller cheaper base model for batch scoring).

Attached is a one‑pager with the POC footprint (Lumen_Requirements_v1.pdf) — the important bits: expected 25k reqs/day, avg prompt 120 tokens, avg generated 320 tokens per request. We’re also interested in any standard volume thresholds you offer (monthly token commits) and indicative discount bands — we don’t need a formal contract yet, just baseline numbers to plug into a TCO comparison.

Can you loop in anyone on your pricing/solutions side who can provide a simple per‑1M IO table plus the model roster? If it helps, I’m available for a 30m call Thu morning PST.

Best,
Elliot
Director of Product, Lumen Health
Attachment: Lumen_Requirements_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 180KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Thomas <elliot@lumenhealth.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Aug 2029 01:06:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per‑1M IO rates + model lineup for hosted API (POC)

Hi Elliot — thanks for the detail and the attachment, that helps a lot. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Marcus (solutions engineer) so you have a single thread. Below is a concise baseline we use for hosted inference; I’ll follow up with a short screening call to confirm your latency needs and whether you want streaming or synchronous output.

Baseline per‑1M token (hosted API) — standard, no enterprise commit:
- Redwood‑base (small, good for bulk scoring): Input $0.30 / 1M, Output $0.50 / 1M
- Redwood‑prose (general-purpose): Input $0.60 / 1M, Output $1.20 / 1M
- Redwood‑chat-xl (low-latency conversational): Input $1.20 / 1M, Output $2.40 / 1M
- Large open variants (quantized): Input $0.90 / 1M, Output $1.80 / 1M

Notes:
- Token counting is standard byte‑pair tokenization — prompts (input) are billed on arrival; generated output tokens billed per token produced. If you use streaming, output billing begins as we return tokens.
- Attachments (like eval datasets) and embeddings are priced separately — let us know if you’ll use embeddings in the POC.

Volume discounts (indicative, applied to total monthly spend):
- 3‑month pilot (no commit): no discount
- 6‑month commit, >= 10M tokens/month: ~10% off list
- 12‑month commit, >= 50M tokens/month: ~18% off list
- Custom pricing available for >200M tokens/month (sales + procurement)

Supported hosted catalog (short list for POC planning):
- redwood-base-1 (small)
- redwood-prose-2 (general purpose)
- redwood-chat-xl-2 (conversational, streaming enabled)
- open‑quant-65b (quantized candidate for batch scoring)
- safety-filter-v1 (optional output filter as a hosted add‑on)

If you want, Marcus can run a quick estimate with your numbers from the attachment and post a short cost table here. Would Thu 10:00am PST work for a 30m sync?

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Elliot Thomas <elliot@lumenhealth.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Team <finance@lumenhealth.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Aug 2029 02:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per‑1M IO rates + model lineup for hosted API (POC)

Thanks Kimberly — that table is perfect. A couple of clarifications before we book Marcus: 1) For the POC numbers in the attachment (25k reqs/day with 120 input / 320 output tokens): which model would you recommend by default for latency <= 400ms 95th percentile? 2) Are the volume discount thresholds on tokens or spend? Our finance team usually models by dollars. 3) Any limits on concurrent requests for the hosted plan we should be aware of (we expect bursts up to ~200 RPS for short periods).

If you can answer these quickly, we can confirm the Thu 10:00am PST slot (works for me).

—Elliot
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Thomas <elliot@lumenhealth.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Aug 2029 09:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quick ask: per‑1M IO rates + model lineup for hosted API (POC)

Hi Elliot — Ben here from Sales. Quick answers while Marcus prepares a tailored estimate for your attachment: 1) For your latency target (<=400ms p95) we usually suggest redwood-chat-xl-2 for conversational flows; redwood-prose-2 can sometimes meet lower-latency needs depending on prompt shape — Marcus will confirm after a quick check. 2) Discount thresholds are applied to total monthly spend; the percentages Kimberly listed are applied to invoiceable dollars once a commit is in place. For your worksheet you can assume the discount bands against the list prices I posted. 3) Hosted concurrent request limits are soft — we support bursts up to 250 RPS for most accounts, and we can provision higher burst capacity for short windows. If you expect sustained high RPS we recommend a small Dedicated pool (we can put a TCO together).

I’ve put together a quick cost calculator link that Marcus will populate with your POC numbers during the call: https://redwood.app/sales/calc/hs-890123 (will return a PDF summary). See you Thu 10:00am PST — I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
